description: Returns a new API key with 50 free checks, and a claim_url where a person can take over the account and add prepaid credits. One key serves every later call.
name: create_api_key

api_key.description: Send as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>. Shown once: store it.

claim_url.description: Where a person claims the account and adds credits. Valid 30 days.

title: Create an API key
